boundaryPolicy: Unmodified Overture Seoul territorial region (KR-11); OSM-derived open data, not a government-certified cadastral boundary.
featureSelection: Keep original building or building_part geometry if it intersects Seoul; do not physically cut boundary-crossing footprints or remove holes.
districtAssignment: Representative interior point if covered by a district; boundary-crossing fallback uses greatest intersection area. Exactly one district per retained feature.
